title: Built a zombie survival game with GPT-6-Astra and Three.js
author: ineedthealgorithm
selftext:
I've been experimenting with **GPT-6-Astra** and **Pixelfork**, and this is probably one of my favorite games I've made so far.

I wanted to make a first-person zombie survival game in the browser and see how far I could go. I started with a simple prompt in Pixelfork, then kept improving it and adding 3D assets from Sketchfab.

This was my initial prompt:

>

From there, I kept improving the environment, zombies, weapons, lighting, effects, and overall game feel.
